activity.role: Movement leader and self-proclaimed Vizier of Bosnia
activity.notes: Bosnian notables selected Gradaščević to lead the autonomy movement in 1831. He proclaimed himself Bosnian vizier, but the Porte never confirmed the title and imperial forces defeated the movement in 1832.

sources.title: Hrvatska enciklopedija — Gradaščević, Husein-beg
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia identifies Gradaščević as leader of the Bosnian autonomy movement, self-proclaimed Bosnian vizier in 1831, and defeated rebel leader in 1832 whose title was never confirmed by the Porte.

review_context.correction_note: Represent the autonomy movement rather than retrojecting the modern state.
